clips.title: The story
paras: Assigned by Dalar Dawnweaver at the Sepulcher, this quest tasks Forsaken agents with securing Arugal's earliest spellbooks from a nearby farmstead. Uncovering the magic behind the worgen curse is vital for the Forsaken to turn it against the mad mage and secure Silverpine Forest. Recovering the Remedy of Arugal marks the first step in unraveling the threat looming from Shadowfang Keep.

Dalar Dawnweaver, an ambitious Forsaken mage residing in the crypts of the Sepulcher, holds no respect for Archmage Arugal. To Dawnweaver, Arugal was an unremarkable practitioner whose inclusion in the Kirin Tor was baffling and whose magical understanding seemed amateurish. However, the monstrous beasts now roaming Silverpine cannot be ignored. To break Arugal's hold on the region, Dawnweaver intends to deconstruct the spells that unleashed the worgen upon Lordaeron.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: How Arugal gained acceptance within the Kirin Tor is beyond me. His spell-casting knowledge seemed as transparent as a blown glass bauble.
What's important now is learning exactly what magic Arugal used so that I can turn it against him and secure Silverpine Forest for the Dark Lady.

Arugal first stayed at the wheat farm just north of the bridge. One of the Deathstalkers reported seeing some spellbooks but could not secure them. Retrieve for me the spell labeled Remedy of Arugal from those books.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Before I know what we are dealing with here, adventurer, I need to study the spell known as Remedy of Arugal. Bring it to me now or I shall be forced to find myself a worthy servant.

clips.title: Completion
paras: This is precisely the spell I was in search of, adventurer. If your dedication to The Dark Lady's cause remains infallible you will find you have quite a future amongst The Forsaken.
